name: Lyra Health vs SonderMind
title: Lyra Health vs SonderMind: Enterprise vs Provider Network Platforms
description: Compare Lyra Health (enterprise workforce solution) vs SonderMind (free therapist credentialing with VA partnership). Different platforms for different mental health market needs.

summary.bottom_line: Lyra Health and SonderMind serve different markets. Lyra Health is an enterprise B2B platform selling workforce mental health benefits to employers (20M+ people, 90+ countries, 3:1 ROI). SonderMind is a free platform for individual therapists offering insurance credentialing, billing, and notably a VA partnership (100% covered for veterans). Employers contract with Lyra; therapists join SonderMind.

key_differences.pricing: Lyra: Custom PEPM | SonderMind: Free (revenue share)
key_differences.unique_value: Lyra: 3:1 ROI, global | SonderMind: VA partnership, free CE

sections.heading: Different Market Positions
sections.content: Lyra Health and SonderMind operate in different segments of mental health. Lyra Health sells enterprise workforce mental health benefits to large employers, providing therapy, coaching, psychiatry, and AI tools with proven 3:1 ROI across 90+ countries. SonderMind is a free platform helping individual therapists accept insurance, with unique features like VA partnership (veterans get 100% coverage) and included continuing education.

sections.heading: Unique Differentiators
sections.content: Lyra Health's differentiators are enterprise: global coverage (90+ countries, 119 languages), peer-reviewed outcomes (2x faster recovery), HR analytics through Lyra Empower, and Lyra AI for mild symptoms. SonderMind's differentiators are provider-focused: free credentialing, in-network VA provider status (100% covered for veterans with referral), Medicare/Medicaid acceptance, premium in-network rates, and free continuing education resources.

recommendations.when: You're an employer (500+ employees) wanting comprehensive workforce mental health benefits with measurable ROI.
You're a therapist wanting free insurance credentialing, especially if you want to serve veterans (VA) or Medicare patients.
You value included continuing education and premium in-network reimbursement rates.

faqs.q: Can a therapist be part of both SonderMind and Lyra's network?
faqs.a: Potentially yes. You could use SonderMind for insurance credentialing and client matching while also applying to be a provider in Lyra's curated network for employer-sponsored clients.

faqs.q: What makes SonderMind's VA partnership special?
faqs.a: SonderMind is an in-network VA provider. With a valid VA referral, therapy is 100% covered by the VA at no cost to veterans, available in all 50 states. This is a unique advantage for therapists wanting to serve veterans.

faqs.q: Which is better for building a private practice?
faqs.a: SonderMind. It's designed for individual therapists with free credentialing, billing, and client matching. Lyra Health is an employer platform, not a practice-building tool.
